items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: I do remember Blind Freddy because he was born blind. I remember him very well... God, I know him, everybody in town knows him.

ctx.x: What bands played in there, do you remember?

Well, you know Blind, I don't know if you all know Blind Freddy. A fellow that would go around there and play harmonica? Well, he had a band at that time, he was playing clarinet. He had a guy playing clarinet, bass player, trumpet player, trombone, drums, and piano. Yeah. They have a banjo on that band? Yeah, that's right. Tenor banjo, clarinet, bass violin, drums, and piano and trombone. Do you remember the banjo player when he was playing? The banjo player? Well, I can't remember the fellow, not so good. I…
